name: English Atlas
desc: A detailed, interactive course in English for learners, especially Chinese speakers: pronunciation, vocabulary and grammar, reading and writing from everyday texts to academic papers, listening and speaking, and the history and varieties of English.
desc_zh: 面向英语学习者、尤其是以中文为母语者的深入、可交互的英语课程：语音、词汇与语法，从日常文本到学术论文的阅读与写作，听说，以及英语的历史与变体。
lede: A detailed, interactive course in how English works, written for learners and especially for Chinese speakers — pronunciation, vocabulary and grammar, reading and writing from everyday texts to academic papers, listening and speaking, the history and varieties of English, and translation between English and Chinese. Courses are arranged by CEFR level, from A1–A2 to C1–C2. This is a skeleton: the courses and chapters are mapped out, and the lessons are still to be written.
lede_zh: 一套深入、可交互的英语课程，讲解英语如何运作，面向英语学习者，尤其是以中文为母语的学习者——语音、词汇与语法，从日常文本到学术论文的阅读与写作，听说，英语的历史与变体，以及英汉互译。课程按欧洲语言共同参考框架（CEFR）的级别编排，从 A1–A2 到 C1–C2。目前这是一个框架：课程与章节已经规划好，课文尚待编写。
foot: a free, detailed and interactive course in the English language, written for learners and especially for Chinese speakers.
foot_zh: 一套免费、详尽、可交互的英语课程，面向英语学习者，尤其是以中文为母语的学习者。
about_lede: English Atlas is a free, detailed course in how English works — its sounds, words and grammar, how it is read, written and spoken, and where it came from — written for learners, especially Chinese speakers, to use alongside classes and textbooks, or on its own.
about_lede_zh: 英语图谱是一套免费、详尽的英语课程，讲解英语如何运作——它的语音、词汇和语法，如何读、写、听、说，以及它从何而来。它面向英语学习者，尤其是以中文为母语的学习者，可以配合课堂和教材使用，也可以单独自学。
timeline_desc: From Old English to a world language: the history behind the English we use today.
timeline_desc_zh: 从古英语到世界性语言：我们今天所用的英语背后的历史。
timeline_lede: How English became the language it is today: invasions and borrowed words, the printing press, dictionaries and grammars, and the spread of English around the world. Coloured dots show the area; links lead to the course where the topic is taught.
timeline_lede_zh: 英语如何成为今天的样子：外族入侵与外来词、印刷术、词典与语法书，以及英语在世界各地的传播。彩色圆点表示所属领域；链接指向讲授相关内容的课程。
card_desc: English for learners, especially Chinese speakers, from level A1 to C2: pronunciation, vocabulary and grammar, reading and writing up to academic papers, listening and speaking, the history and varieties of English, and English–Chinese translation. The curriculum is mapped out; the lessons are still to be written.
card_desc_zh: 面向英语学习者、尤其是以中文为母语者的英语课程，从 A1 到 C2 级：语音、词汇与语法，直至学术论文的阅读与写作，听说，英语的历史与变体，以及英汉互译。课程体系已经规划好，课文尚待编写。
sources: The lessons are original texts that describe English as it is used today, following the major reference grammars and dictionaries, and each course page recommends books for further study. Example sentences are written for the atlas, and longer passages come only from texts in the public domain. This atlas is still a skeleton: the courses and chapters are mapped out, and the lessons are still to be written.
sources_zh: 课文均为原创，依据主要的参考语法书和词典，描述当今实际使用的英语；每门课程页面都推荐了延伸学习的书目。例句均为本图谱专门编写，较长的引文只取自已进入公有领域的作品。本图谱目前还只是框架：课程与章节已经规划好，课文尚待编写。

page_desc: Every definition and rule in the atlas, with its statement and a link to the lesson.
图谱中的每一条定义和规则，附有表述和指向相应课文的链接。
page_lede: Every numbered definition and rule in the atlas with its exact statement. Follow a link to read the explanation, the examples around it and the exercises that use it.
图谱中每一条带编号的定义和规则及其准确表述。点击链接即可阅读相应的解释、相关例句以及用到它的练习。
about_definition: Clear definitions of the terms we use, numbered so they can be referred to.
对所用术语的清晰定义，带编号以便引用。
about_theorem: Rules of usage stated plainly, with an explanation of when they apply, where they have exceptions and how British and American usage differ.
用平实的语言陈述用法规则，并解释它们何时适用、有哪些例外，以及英式与美式用法有何不同。
about_example: Example sentences, with what each one shows.
例句，并说明每个例句说明了什么。
about_intuition: The idea behind a rule, in plain words.
用平实的话讲清楚规则背后的道理。
report: If you find an error, please report it on %s, noting the chapter and the number of the rule, example or exercise.
如果发现错误，欢迎在 %s 上反馈，并注明所在章节以及规则、例子或练习的编号。

areas.label: Pronunciation
areas.blurb: The sounds of English, how words are stressed, and the rhythm and melody of speech.
areas.blurb_zh: 英语的语音、单词的重音，以及话语的节奏与语调。

areas.label: Vocabulary
areas.blurb: Building a vocabulary: the most useful words, how words are made, and which words go together.
areas.blurb_zh: 积累词汇：最常用的词、词是怎样构成的，以及哪些词常常搭配在一起。

areas.label: Grammar
areas.blurb: How English sentences are built, from the basic patterns to tense, articles, clauses and modality.
areas.blurb_zh: 英语句子是怎样构成的：从基本句型到时态、冠词、从句和情态。

areas.label: Reading
areas.blurb: Reading for meaning, from everyday texts to academic articles and literature.
areas.blurb_zh: 为理解而读：从日常文本到学术文章和文学作品。

areas.label: Writing
areas.blurb: Writing clear English, from sentences and paragraphs to essays, research papers and style.
areas.blurb_zh: 写出清楚的英语：从句子和段落到议论文、研究论文和文体。

areas.label: Listening & speaking
areas.blurb: Listening and conversation, presentations and discussion, and the unwritten rules of polite talk.
areas.blurb_zh: 听力与会话、演讲与讨论，以及得体交谈中不成文的规矩。

areas.label: Language studies
areas.blurb: English as an object of study: its structure, its history, its varieties around the world, and translation between English and Chinese.
areas.blurb_zh: 把英语作为研究对象：它的结构、历史、世界各地的变体，以及英汉互译。
